Description.SourceString:
Our formidable R&D department have discovered how a penguin may wear jewellery WITHOUT resorting to rings. They have invented something called the AMULET, and it brings all of the benefits of a ring, but without having to sew on clumsy human fingers. Its effect is somewhat different, but no less powerful.

This is yet another example of penguin ingenuity and intellectual dominance. Praise Acheron that you won the genetic lottery and were born a penguin!
